items.description: CPCL detects image forgeries by enforcing consistency in illumination, reflectance, and geometry. Using a hybrid physics proxy and causal graph network, it identifies violations of physical laws. Experiments show it outperforms artifact-based methods and generalizes across generative models.

items.name: Causal-Invariant-Representation-Decomposition-for-Multi-Site-Clinical-Distribution-Shift
items.description: Adversarial stable/spurious representation decomposition for site-generalizable clinical risk prediction. Evaluated via Leave-One-Site-Out generalization, calibration, and missing-feature-group robustness on the real 4-site UCI Heart Disease dataset, against ERM and IRM baselines — with full ablation and significance testing.
